newsitem.title: USA: Texas inmates fall ill after eating unusual cake.
newsitem.headline: Texas inmates fall ill after eating unusual cake.

text.p: Dozens of inmates at three Texas jails have more reason than ever to complain about prison food after getting sick from a lemon cake adulterated with lemon-scented detergent, officials said on Tuesday.
Police said staff working for a prison food contractor had apparently mixed the detergent instead of lemon flavoring into a batch of the cake.
"The two liquids come in the same type of bottle but if they'd read the label, they'd have known they were different," said Lt. John Dalton of the Tarrant County Sheriff's Department.
The cake was served up at three county jail facilities in Fort Worth last Friday night. Soon after the meal, between 80 and 100 prisoners began vomiting or complaining of stomach cramps and nausea.
An investigation was under way to determine who was responsible and whether the contamination was deliberate or accidental.
